author: SA Editors' Picks
title: Are FAANG Stocks In 'Correction' Mode? - Today's Editors' Picks
text:
FAANG lost a combined $185 billion of market cap over the past few days, but does that mean they’re in the midst of a large correction? Analysts have a myriad of opinions. One notable analyst mentions that the leader of the group, Apple ( AAPL ) may lost a third of its value while some others, such as SA contributor Eric Parnell, CFA believe that investors should remain calm.
Our contributors keep their ears to the ground and their eyes on the screen looking for profitable opportunities in the marketplace. Today, contributors AllStar Trader , Hoya Capital Real Estate , Michael Turner , J Mintzmyer , Centaur Investments , Dividend Sensei , Yves Sukhu , and New Deal Democrat bring us some of the best ideas. Let us know which is your favorite in the comment section below.
Here are today’s Editors’ Picks:
Trex Co (AllStar Trader) Equity Lifestyle Properties (Hoya Capital Real Estate) Genworth Mtg Ins Australia (Michael Turner) Teekay LNG Partners (J Mintzmyer) Adient plc (Centaur Investments) AbbVie Inc (Dividend Sensei) IBM (Yves Sukhu) Slowdown likely, but no recession (New Deal Democrat) Chart of the day: Corporate Bond Yields
Comment of the day, by contributor Moon Kil Woong
Energy is a good play, esp oil, right now for the long term. All groups of stocks have their ups and downs. FANG's correction is not that bad if you own all of FANG. The issue is that the run up of a few of the stocks is due to the fact people are betting on those individual stocks or over weighting their FANG investments to try to goose their gains. Now they are looking at goosed up losses. Congrats. FANG will correct and rise again, hopefully not on the back of greedy trend line followers.
Image of the day: MoviePass
Fun Fact Of The Day:
The Warlocks, a rock band from the greater San Francisco area had to change their name once they found out that another band, one based on the east coast, was already using it and signed to a record deal. The band ended up changing their name to the Grateful Dead. The other Warlocks, also ended up changing their name to The Velvet Underground.
